_readme: Business-level annotations merged with live DB schema at runtime. Add/update entries here when meaning changes; structural schema (columns, types, FKs) is always fetched live from the DB.

card_db.description: Core user identity table. Every person who interacts with the centre has a card_db record. 'cardno' is the universal guest identifier used as FK in all booking tables.

columns.cardno: Universal User ID — use this in all joins with booking tables
columns.type: User category: PR (permanent resident), MUMUKSHU (spiritual seeker), SEVA KUTIR, GUEST
columns.res_status: Current on-premise status: onprem (currently staying) or offprem

room_booking.description: Room reservation requests. One row per user stay. Supports waitlist and Utsav-linked bookings.

food_db.description: Food booking records. One row per guest per date. Boolean flags for each meal.

columns.date: Date for which food is booked (DATEONLY)

travel_db.description: Travel arrangement bookings — pickup/dropoff to/from railway stations or airports.
travel_db.statusFlow: waiting → proceed for payment → confirmed | admin cancelled | cancelled | seats full cancel | wrong form cancel

columns.status: Booking lifecycle: waiting, proceed for payment, confirmed, cancelled, admin cancelled, seats full cancel, wrong form cancel

shibir_booking_db.description: Adhyayan (spiritual education program / shibir) bookings. 'shibir' and 'adhyayan' are used interchangeably in the codebase.

shibir_db.description: Adhyayan/shibir program catalogue. One row per program offering.

utsav_booking.description: Utsav (festival/special event) bookings. Guests book attendance at specific events and packages.

utsav_db.description: Utsav (festival) event catalogue. Each row is one festival event.

utsav_packages_db.description: Package options available within a specific utsav event.

flat_booking.description: Flat/apartment bookings for mumukshus who stay for extended periods.

transactions.description: Payment records. One row per payment attempt. Links back to a booking via booking_ref + booking_type discriminator. Handles Razorpay, cash, UPI, and internal credit payments.

columns.booking_type: Discriminator: room | food | travel | adhyayan | utsav | flat — determines which *_booking table booking_ref points to
columns.booking_ref: FK into the table identified by booking_type (polymorphic)
columns.razorpay_order_id: Razorpay order ID if payment_mode = razorpay_callback
columns.status: pending | completed | failed | authorized | captured | awaiting refund | cash pending | cash completed | credited

roomdb.description: Physical room inventory. Each row is one bookable slot (bookno) within a room.

columns.bookno: Slot number within the room (for multi-bed rooms)

guest_db.description: Guest relationship records — temporary visitors brought by a resident.

columns.cardno: FK → card_db.cardno — the resident who brought the guest

blockdates.description: Admin-managed date blocks that prevent bookings on specific dates or date ranges.

columns.booking_type: Which booking type is blocked: room | food | travel | all

columns.role: Role determining admin permissions — see admin_roles table

admin_roles.description: Role definitions for admin portal access control.

columns.role: Role name: superAdmin | roomAdmin | cardAdmin | officeAdmin | adhyayanAdmin | utsavAdmin | etc.

gate_record.description: Entry/exit gate log. Tracks when guests arrive at and depart from the centre.

bulk_food_booking.description: Admin-created bulk food bookings applied to groups of guests at once.

columns.booking_type: The food meal type this bulk booking covers

food_physical_plate.description: Physical plate tokens issued for food. Used for kitchen headcount.

foodrate.description: Current food pricing per meal type.

shibir_attendance_db.description: Day-level attendance records for adhyayan programs.

updates.description: App update / announcement records pushed to users.

razorpay_webhook.description: Raw Razorpay webhook event log. Used for debugging payment discrepancies.

razorpay_settlement.description: Razorpay settlement summary records for reconciliation.

razorpay_settlement_recon.description: Line-item reconciliation entries within a Razorpay settlement.

permanent_wifi_codes.description: Permanent Wi-Fi codes for long-term residents.

departments.description: Department / seva (service) area catalogue used for staff assignments.

cities.description: Reference list of cities for address fields.

glossary.cardno: Universal user identifier, it's the person's permanent ID
glossary.shibir / adhyayan: Used interchangeably. Spiritual education programs held at the centre. Tables prefixed shibir_ correspond to adhyayan domain.
glossary.utsav: Festival or special event at the centre. Users book utsav attendance separately from regular room/food bookings.
glossary.mumukshu: A spiritual seeker — the primary guest category. Eligible for flat bookings and long-term stays.
glossary.PR (permanent resident): card_db.type value for residents who live at the centre permanently
glossary.booking_ref polymorphic FK: transactions.booking_ref points to the PK of the booking table identified by transactions.booking_type. E.g. booking_type='room' means booking_ref is a room_booking.id
glossary.proceed for payment: Intermediate booking status after waitlist approval but before payment is completed
glossary.WL: Waitlist abbreviation used in room booking comments
